bibl.title: Some Aspects of Monastic Diets from Thebes. A Comparative Study of the Consumption of Fish and Meat.
bibl.seg: Hind Salah El-Din Somida Awad, Some Aspects of Monastic Diets from Thebes. A Comparative Study of the Consumption of Fish and Meat.
Scrinium. Journal of Patrology and Critical Hagiography 16 (2020) pp. 48-57.
bibl.note: Investigates the consumption of fish and meat in the monastic diets of Thebes from the sixth to the eighth centuries AD, and other monastic sites of Middle Egypt, as well as in Palestine.
